Hi Sofia \u0014 thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap and three asks so we can move pricing to your procurement team: 

Recap from today's call (Finex / Redwood):
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + routing (real-time snippets + nightly full-archive embedding jobs).
- Expected steady-state volume: ~50M tokens / month (peaks up to 80M/month in Q4).
- Latency requirement: 150-300ms for single-shot generation endpoints.
- Data controls: VPC/Private deployment desirable; initial proof in Redwood Hosted.

Pricing inputs we discussed and what we need to confirm:
1) Target unit economics: you mentioned wanting ~$/1M-token target so model/unit cost fits Finex's projections. Can you confirm the target range (you said low-mid 4 digits \u0014 would that be $900\u0013$1,500 per 1M tokens?)
2) Budget owner / economic buyer: who is the person who will sign off on the contract budget and final pricing? (name + email)
3) Finance procurement timeline: when will your procurement/finance team need the formal quote to include in the next budget cycle?

Attached I put a quick estimate (redwood_pricing_estimate_20260304.xlsx) based on the 50M/month volume and two pricing bands (hosted vs. dedicated). The high-level per-1M numbers in that sheet are illustrative \u0014 we will finalize once you confirm the econ buyer + budget range.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm econ buyer + budget owner (reply inline).
- If agreed, we schedule a 30-min pricing alignment with your finance person and our pricing lead (Aditya). Suggested slots: Thu 3/5 10:00\u001311:00am PT or Fri 3/6 2:00\u00133:00pm PT.

Thanks \u0014 I'm looping in Aditya (cc) to prep the pricing breakdown and Neha from Customer Success to document rollout expectations once procurement is complete.

Best,

- Cost to serve (estimated): $350\u0013$600 / 1M tokens (depends on model/quantization & batching).
- Margin / reinvestment range expected at price points above.

2) Confirm target $/1M token range (Sofia suggested $1,200 +/- 25%). If that holds, we'll draft a formal quote with the 12-month committed option prioritized.
3) Pick a time for a 30-min call with Aditya to go over the price breakout and technical ops (Aditya is the pricing/solutions lead). Suggested: Thu 3/5 10:00am PT.

I've attached a slightly updated estimate and an initial mutual action plan (same files as before) for your review.

Thanks \u0014 Marissa
